text:
Alex: midweek capacity dry-run — did a simulated drain on ams1 lane, spotted a fallback race when spot instances terminated, logging below
Maria: thanks — can you paste the failing log snippet?
Alex: paste: `2026-03-16T10:14:02Z ERROR fallback: no compatible variant in pool, enqueueing retry`
Alex: steps I did: 1) triggered drain on node pool `ams1-gpu-pool-b`; 2) watched autoscaler + provisioner; 3) verified model routing fallback to cpu-small for low-priority jobs
Chen: blocker: quota bump for AMS region still pending (ticket #INC-842). If we can't reserve more spot capacity we'll hit tails during peak
Devon: FYI I saw >30% token latency spike when fallback to cpu-small happened, added a temporary routing rule to prefer dedicated variants for routes /generate-heavy
Sam: quick ask — do you need me to escalate quota with cloud-ops? I can loop in infra-quotas@cloud if needed
Alex: yes please @Sam escalate, add the specific SKU: `gpu-v100-16g` and target 12 extra units for next 72h window
Maria: noticed some oddness in the provisioner logs — there's a race where two provisioners claim the same spot candidate. I'm opening a small PR to add a compare-and-swap lease for candidates
Devon: ping on the PR link?
Maria: PR -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/provisioner/merge_requests/219 : adds `candidate_lease()` with backoff
deploy-bot: deployment started: provisioner/219 -> canary (sha: b53a7f1) :gear:
Alex: rolling canary now in eu-west1 and us-east1, leaving ams1 excluded until we validate
Chen: update on quota ticket: cloud-ops replied, provisional approval for 6 units, they want usage pattern for weekend surge before increasing further
Sam: provided weekend surge CSV (attached) and note that we need headroom for model rollout on Saturday
Alex: short-term mitigation: 1) prefer dedicated pool for active canary traffic, 2) enable soft-eviction to keep tails warm, 3) reduce batch-window for /embed routes to lower token latency
Devon: I can flip dedicated preference for canary routes — will do in ~10m and post the config diff
Devon: config diff snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  - route: /v1/generate
    prefer: dedicated
    fallback: cpu-small
```
Sam: after Devon flips, I'll monitor the per-route latency dashboard and alert if p95 > 800ms for >5min
Maria: blocker: my PR added a new DB index and I'm waiting for migration window approval — if we can't run migration quickly it delays fix for candidate leases
Alex: migration not urgent for live traffic but it'd be nice to get before weekend. Ops, any preferred window?
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance window available: Sat 03:00–05:00 UTC
Chen: that window works for me, I'll coordinate with cloud-ops for quota follow-up before then
Alex: today: validate canary in eu-west1/us-east1, confirm latency after Devon's change, confirm quota escalation (Sam), and plan migration for Sat window if approved
Sam: will escalate now and post updates here
Devon: flipping routing preference in 5m — will post ping once done
Maria: will monitor provisioner canary logs and comment on MR; if we see duplicate claims after lease change I'll roll back
Chen: I'll keep an eye on quota thread and attach usage graphs
Alex: thanks all — short async check-in. Mark items: escalate quota (Sam), canary validation (Alex/Devon), migration window coord (Chen/Maria), keep ams1 on hold until we confirm no regression :thumbsup:
